concepts.label: n3-transport
concepts.gloss: The N3 transport is the user-plane transport path that carries PDUs and terminates at the UPF transport endpoint.

concepts.label: upf-transport-endpoint
concepts.gloss: The upf-transport-endpoint is the demarcation point in the user plane where the N3 transport terminates, associated with the N3 transport.

concepts.label: n3-dscp
concepts.gloss: The n3-dscp is the QoS marking configuration applied to the N3 transport, mapping to DSCP values such as EF and AF41.

concepts.label: n3-capacity
concepts.gloss: The n3-capacity is the required transport capacity (throughput) of the N3 path.

concepts.label: n3-mtu
concepts.gloss: The n3-mtu defines the framing MTU used by the N3 transport.

concepts.label: qos-flow
concepts.gloss: The qos-flow is a core QoS construct representing a traffic flow within a PDU session.

concepts.label: pdu-session
concepts.gloss: The pdu-session is the core-state object representing a PDU session that carries data over the N3 transport.

concepts.label: summit-tag-9
concepts.gloss: The summit-tag-9 is an opaque, vendor-specific attribute attached to the N3 transport to carry proprietary tagging information.
